obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ±10 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the measurement axis, and ±1 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the perpendicular direction to the measurement axis
obligations.ears: A recess in the sphere of the headform impactor shall allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ±10 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the measurement axis, and ±1 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the perpendicular direction to the measurement axis.

derived.text: A recess in the sphere shall allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ±10 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the measurement axis.

A recess in the sphere shall allow for mounting one triaxial or three uniaxial accelerometers within ±1 mm seismic mass location tolerance from the centre of the sphere for the perpendicular direction to the measurement axis.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: one of the accelerometers shall have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 6) and its seismic mass shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length
obligations.ears: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, one of the accelerometers shall have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 6) and its seismic mass shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length.

derived.text: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, one of the accelerometers shall have its sensitive axis perpendicular to the mounting face A (see Figure 6).
If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the seismic mass of that accelerometer shall be positioned within a cylindrical tolerance field of 1 mm radius and 20 mm length.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: run perpendicular to the mounting face and its mid-point shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor
obligations.ears: The centre line of the tolerance field shall run perpendicular to the mounting face and its mid-point shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

derived.text: The centre line of the tolerance field shall run perpendicular to the mounting face.
The mid-point of the centre line of the tolerance field shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A and their seismic mass shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius
obligations.ears: The remaining accelerometers shall have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A and their seismic mass shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius.

derived.text: The remaining accelerometers shall have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A.
The seismic mass of the remaining accelerometers shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor
obligations.ears: The centre of the tolerance field shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.ears: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 1,000.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.ears: The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 500 g for the acceleration.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: A rear flat face shall be provided on the outer surface of the headform impactors which is perpendicular to the direction of travel, and typically perpendicular to the axis of one of the accelerometers as well as being a flat plate capable of providing for access to the accelerometers and an attachment point for the propulsion system
obligations.ears: The child and adult headform impactors shall have a rear flat face provided on the outer surface which is perpendicular to the direction of travel, and typically perpendicular to the axis of one of the accelerometers as well as being a flat plate capable of providing for access to the accelerometers and an attachment point for the propulsion system.
